title: MCP Security Bench (MSB): Benchmarking Attacks Against Model Context Protocol in LLM Agents
authors: Dongsen Zhang; Zekun Li; Xu Luo; Xuannan Liu; Peipei Li; Wenjun Xu
why_relevant: Benchmarks attacks on MCP-based LLM agents including a retrieval injection attack, tangentially relevant to adversarial corruption in tool/retrieval pipelines.
why_not_or_caveat: Focus is on MCP tool-use agent security rather than RAG robustness; retrieval injection is only one of 12 attack types in an agent context.
